A desktop workspace for Codex agents. Hand off coding and research tasks, let them run side by side in their own worktrees, and come back to results — with only the decisions that need you, flagged.

How it works

One request in. Many paths out.

01 — Hand off

Pick a project, describe the work, attach the files and memories it should see. Theseus snapshots the context when the run starts.

02 — Split

Separate tasks run in parallel live slots, each in its own Git worktree so they never trip over the same checkout.

03 — Reroute

Dead ends happen. Failed runs are labeled, their output is kept, and you decide whether to retry or fork from the last good commit.

04 — Report back

Finished work lands with its diff, checks and next action. Anything waiting on a decision rises to the top as Needs you.

  • Working
  • Failed · retrying
  • Needs you
  • In review

Hand off with context

Say what you want. Show what matters.

Context is a deliberate choice, not a guess. Review a file before it goes in, add a built-in workflow, and choose where the run happens.

  • Reviewed project filesUp to five files, checked against the hash you reviewed.
  • /review, /explain, $plan, $testBuilt-in prompt workflows you can preview before adding.
  • New Git worktreeA fresh branch from HEAD, so your checkout stays untouched.

Many tasks. Running at once.

Eight lanes. Zero collisions.

Give Theseus up to eight live slots. Each task gets its own worktree, queued work starts the moment a slot frees up, and Grid view lets you watch them all.

4/8 live4 queued

    Separate tasks run in parallel. Steps inside one crew run in order.

    Only what needs you

    Stop babysitting. Get pinged for decisions.

    Sessions sort themselves into Needs you, Working, Paused and Finished. When something is waiting on a call only you can make, it rises to the top — with the button to make it.

    Approval cards shown here are sample states. Live runs use a non-interactive safety policy.

    Forge builds. Sentinel reviews.

    Two agents. One honest handoff.

    Run Build → Review as a crew: Forge implements, then Sentinel inspects the actual diff with read-only access. Turn any finding into a focused fix run.

    Everything in one window

    The tools stay next to the work.

    Terminals, previews, research, memory and routines — tied to the same project and run, so you never lose the thread between an agent's output and what it changed.

    Managed worktreesEvery task on its own branch.Concurrent runs never share a canonical checkout. Your uncommitted work stays where it is.
